shortDescription: Create and Delete Topics/Subscriptions, Publish and pull messages on PubSub

options.name: credentials_file
options.description: path to the JSON file associated with the service account email

options.name: publish
options.description: List of dictionaries describing messages and attributes to be published.  Dictionary is in message(str):attributes(dict) format. Only message is required.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the topic or queue. Applies to the most granular resource. If subscription isspecified we remove it. If only topic is specified, that is what is removed. NOTE - A topic can be removed without first removing the subscription.

options.name: subscription
options.description: Dictionary containing a subscription name associated with a topic (required), along with optional ack_deadline, push_endpoint and pull. For pulling from a subscription, message_ack (bool), max_messages (int) and return_immediate are available as subfields. See subfields name, push_endpoint and ack_deadline for more information.

options.name: topic
options.description: GCP pubsub topic name. Only the name, not the full path, is required.
